violations.description: Committed .env file containing sensitive credentials.
violations.evidence: .env contains SECRET_KEY and DB_PASSWORD assignments.
violations.recommendation: Remove .env from version control and use environment variables or a secure secrets manager.

violations.description: Insecure pull_request_target workflow with PR head checkout and script injection.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/pr-bot.yml uses pull_request_target, checks out PR head sha, and evaluates github.event.pull_request.title in run step.
violations.recommendation: Avoid pull_request_target with PR head checkout and pass untrusted event data via environment variables.

violations.description: CI workflow branch filter mismatches default branch.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers on push to develop while default branch is main.
violations.recommendation: Configure CI to trigger on push and pull request to main and develop branches.

violations.description: CI test execution step ignores test failures.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml uses continue-on-error: true on pytest run step.
violations.recommendation: Remove continue-on-error: true so that test failures correctly fail the CI pipeline.

violations.description: Release workflow publishes to PyPI on push without gating tests or build validation.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml publishes package on push to main without running tests.
violations.recommendation: Gated release workflow with required test and build verification jobs before publishing.

violations.description: CI workflow grants overly permissive write-all permissions.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml sets permissions: write-all.
violations.recommendation: Follow principle of least privilege by specifying exact required permissions.

violations.description: Hardcoded API key present in application configuration.
violations.evidence: app/config.py contains API_KEY = "[REDACTED]".
violations.recommendation: Load API keys from environment variables via os.environ.

violations.description: Hardcoded database password in connection string.
violations.evidence: app/config.py contains DATABASE_URL with embedded password.
violations.recommendation: Load database credentials securely from environment variables.

violations.description: Dockerfile uses mutable latest base image tag.
violations.evidence: Dockerfile starts with FROM python:latest.
violations.recommendation: Pin base image to a specific minor version tag (e.g., python:3.11-slim).

violations.description: Dockerfile runs container as root user without switching to non-root USER.
violations.evidence: Dockerfile lacks a USER instruction, causing the application to run as root.
violations.recommendation: Add a non-root USER and group for running the application securely.

violations.description: Dockerfile installs packages without version pinning.
violations.evidence: Dockerfile runs pip install flask requests numpy without version pins.
violations.recommendation: Pin package versions in Dockerfile to ensure reproducible builds.

violations.description: Bare except clause catches all exceptions indiscriminately.
violations.evidence: app/main.py contains except: without exception type specification.
violations.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions (e.g. FileNotFoundError, JSONDecodeError) instead of a bare except.

violations.description: No linter or formatter configured anywhere in the repository.
violations.evidence: Repository contains no configuration or CI steps for linters or formatters (e.g., ruff, flake8, black).
violations.recommendation: Configure a linter and formatter such as ruff or flake8/black for code quality enforcement.

violations.description: Hardcoded debug flag enabled in configuration.
violations.evidence: app/config.py contains DEBUG = True.
violations.recommendation: Default DEBUG to False and control via environment variables.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path hardcoded in configuration.
violations.evidence: app/config.py contains DATA_DIR = "/home/alice/projects/demo/data".
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or environment variables for data directories.

violations.description: Conflicting dependency specifications across manifests and missing lockfile.
violations.evidence: pyproject.toml and requirements.txt specify conflicting/differing dependency constraints without an application lockfile.
violations.recommendation: Consolidate dependency manifests and generate an application lockfile.

violations.description: Empty test body in test function.
violations.evidence: tests/test_main.py contains test_load_items_missing_file with pass body.
violations.recommendation: Implement proper test assertions for missing file handling.

violations.description: Wildcard import used in Python source file.
violations.evidence: app/main.py contains from os.path import *.
violations.recommendation: Import specific functions explicitly instead of using wildcard imports.

violations.description: Missing repository README file.
violations.evidence: No README file found at any path in the repository.
violations.recommendation: Add a comprehensive README.md describing the project, installation, and usage.

violations.description: Tracked local IDE settings file in repository.
violations.evidence: .idea/workspace.xml is tracked in version control.
violations.recommendation: Add .idea/ to .gitignore and remove from tracking.

violations.description: Tracked bytecode cache file in repository.
violations.evidence: __pycache__/main.cpython-312.pyc is tracked in version control.
violations.recommendation: Add __pycache__/ to .gitignore and remove compiled Python files from tracking.

violations.description: Tracked log file in repository.
violations.evidence: debug.log is tracked in version control.
violations.recommendation: Add *.log to .gitignore and remove debug.log from tracking.
